quota_name: Amazon Quick Automate Maximum Automation Groups
description: Maximum number of Automation Groups allowed per account in Amazon Quick Automate

quota_name: Amazon Quick Automate Maximum Automations
description: Maximum number of Automations allowed across all Automation Groups in Amazon Quick Automate

quota_name: Amazon Quick Automate Maximum Concurrent Executions per Trigger
description: Maximum number of concurrent executions per trigger in Amazon Quick Automate

quota_name: Amazon Quick Automate Maximum Concurrent Tests and Deployed Executions
description: Maximum number of concurrent tests and executions per account in Amazon Quick Automate

quota_name: Amazon Quick Automate Maximum Credentials
description: Maximum number of credentials allowed across all Automation Groups in Amazon Quick Automate

quota_name: Amazon Quick Automate Maximum Nesting Depth
description: Maximum nesting depth allowed in an automation in Amazon Quick Automate

quota_name: Amazon Quick Automate Maximum Triggers per Automation
description: Maximum number of triggers allowed per automation in Amazon Quick Automate

quota_name: Amazon Quick Automate Maximum Workflow Execution Time
description: Maximum workflow execution time in hours in Amazon Quick Automate

quota_name: API_CREATE-INGESTION: Calls per 24 hour period from Enterprise edition
description: The maximum number of calls to the createIngestion API function in a floating 24-hour window. The time period is measured starting 24 hours before the current date and time. This maximum applies to AWS accounts that use Amazon QuickSight Enterprise edition.

quota_name: API_CREATE-INGESTION: Calls per 24 hour period from Standard edition
description: The maximum number of calls to the createIngestion API function in a floating 24-hour window. The time period is measured starting 24 hours before the current date and time. This maximum applies to AWS accounts that use Amazon QuickSight Standard edition.

quota_name: Calculated field expression length
description: The maximum number of characters that you can use in an expression for a calculated field.

quota_name: Conversation history retention in days
description: The number of days conversation history is retained before deletion.

quota_name: Custom action name length
description: The maximum number of characters that you can use in naming a custom action.

quota_name: Custom actions per visual
description: The maximum number of custom actions that you can configure for each visual in an analysis.

quota_name: Custom agent artifact retention in days
description: The number of days custom agent artifacts are retained before deletion.

quota_name: Data Prep: Fields per dataset
description: The maximum number of fields that a dataset can contain. File imports and query result sets can contain more than 2,000 columns. However, you must edit the dataset settings and manually exclude fields until there are less than 2,000 selected or included.

quota_name: Display items per sheet control
description: The maximum number of distinct items that a sheet control can display.

quota_name: Email aliases per group for email reports
description: The maximum number of members in any group that QuickSight sends email reports to. If you try to send reports to larger groups, the report fails.

quota_name: In-folder conversation history retention in days
description: The number of days conversation history in a folder is retained before deletion.

quota_name: Maximum active sessions per user
description: The maximum number of concurrent active sessions a user can have.

quota_name: Maximum applicable groups per approval policy
description: The maximum number of group ARNs that can be specified in an approval policy's ApplicableTo configuration (the groups the policy applies to).

quota_name: Maximum approver groups per approval policy
description: The maximum number of approver group ARNs that can be specified in an approval policy's ApprovalGroups configuration (the groups that can approve requests).

quota_name: Maximum artifact file size
description: The maximum size in megabytes (MBs) of a single artifact stored in personal space.

quota_name: Maximum concurrent runs per user
description: The maximum number of active conversations with concurrent runs a user can have.

quota_name: Maximum concurrent tool executions
description: The maximum number of tool executions that can run concurrently within a conversation.

quota_name: Maximum custom agent files size
description: The maximum total size in gigabytes (GBs) of files associated with a custom agent.

quota_name: Maximum custom agent instruction length
description: The maximum number of characters allowed in a custom agent instruction.

quota_name: Maximum file attachment size
description: The maximum size in megabytes (MBs) of a single file attachment.

quota_name: Maximum installed and draft custom agents
description: The maximum combined number of installed and draft custom agents a user can have.

quota_name: Maximum installed connectors
description: The maximum number of connectors (A2A and MCP) a user can have installed.

quota_name: Maximum memory and knowledge graph size
description: The maximum combined size in gigabytes (GBs) of memory and knowledge graph data per user.

quota_name: Maximum number of approval policies per account
description: The maximum number of approval policies that can be created in a single account across all asset types.

quota_name: Maximum number of approval policies per asset type
description: The maximum number of approval policies per asset type (for example, KNOWLEDGE_BASE) within a single account.

quota_name: Maximum number of characters per specified Control values
description: The maximum number of characters used in the entries that you type in to display inside sheet controls. An example is the values specified for a dropdown. This doesn't apply to values created from a dataset.

quota_name: Maximum number of reference documents per chat agent
description: The maximum number of reference documents that can be attached to a chat agent.

quota_name: Maximum number of resources per chat agent
description: The maximum number of resources that can be associated with a chat agent.

quota_name: Maximum number of resources per space
description: The maximum number of resources that can be linked to a space.

quota_name: Maximum number of uploaded files per space
description: The maximum number of files that can be uploaded to a space.

quota_name: Maximum reference file size
description: The maximum size in megabytes (MBs) of a single reference file.

quota_name: Maximum scheduled task instruction length
description: The maximum number of characters allowed in a scheduled task instruction.

quota_name: Maximum scheduled tasks per user
description: The maximum number of scheduled tasks a user can create across all triggers.

quota_name: Maximum skill size
description: The maximum size in megabytes (MBs) of a single skill bundle.

quota_name: Maximum skills per user
description: The maximum number of skills a user can create.

quota_name: Maximum total artifact storage per user
description: The maximum total size in megabytes (MBs) of all artifacts stored in a user's personal space.

quota_name: Maximum total data capacity of an index
description: The maximum total data capacity in megabytes (MBs) of an index.

quota_name: Maximum total size of attached reference documents per chat agent
description: The maximum size in megabytes (MBs) of all reference documents attached to a chat agent.

quota_name: Maximum total size of uploaded files per space
description: The maximum size in gigabytes (GBs) of all files uploaded to a space.

quota_name: Minimum schedule interval in minutes
description: The minimum interval, in minutes, allowed between scheduled task runs.

quota_name: Pinned and in-folder conversation history retention in days
description: The number of days conversation history that is both pinned and in a folder is retained before deletion.

quota_name: Pinned conversation history retention in days
description: The number of days pinned conversation history is retained before deletion.

quota_name: Query timeout for visuals
description: The maximum amount of time that QuickSight waits for a database to finish sending data. This applies to queries initiated by visuals.

quota_name: Scheduled task history retention in days
description: The number of days scheduled task run history is retained.

quota_name: Session approval expiry in hours
description: The number of hours before a session approval expires and must be renewed.

quota_name: The maximum amount of time to wait for a dataset preview
description: The maximum amount of time that QuickSight waits for a data preview to finish loading.

quota_name: URL action hyperlink length
description: The maximum number of characters allowed in the hyperlink (URL) of a custom action that's defined as a URL action. This includes all variations of the link for the different parameters you include.
